description: This file defines the GlobGroup class used for pattern matching of module or path strings, including pattern parsing and matching logic.

classes.name: GlobGroup
classes.description: A class for managing include/exclude glob patterns and matching candidate strings against them.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing include and exclude pattern lists and separator.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns debug string representation of the GlobGroup instance.

methods.name: __repr__
methods.description: Returns debug string representation of the GlobGroup instance.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if a candidate string matches the include patterns and does not match the exclude patterns.

methods.name: _glob_list
methods.description: Converts pattern(s) into a list of compiled regex patterns.

methods.name: _glob_to_re
methods.description: Converts a glob pattern string into a compiled regex pattern.
